description: Comment "Claim" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to find all the money the government secretly owes you? I tried this and it literally found $804 sitting in a government database with my name on it. Here's how: Prompt 1: Go to ChatGPT, choose Work at the top, and say: "Search my state and country's official unclaimed property database for money listed under my name and check every state I've ever lived in." ChatGPT searches real government databases full of forgotten deposits, old refunds, and checks that never got cashed. Your name might be sitting on one right now. Prompt 2: "Now check the places everyone forgets. 401ks from past jobs, unclaimed tax refunds, and any class action settlements I might qualify for." ChatGPT sweeps every source of money you didn't know was yours. Here's the trick: Prompt 3: "@browser Now actually go and claim everything you found and fill out whatever you can for me." ChatGPT opens its own browser and starts claiming it for you. People are finding hundreds of dollars doing this in about 10 minutes. #chatgpt #ai #chatgptprompts #freemoney #aitools
